summary: T04 first timed event resource verified: stable URL/UID mapping, valid canonical VCALENDAR on GET, HEAD headers match without body, and ETag rotates only with canonical content. All 9 integration tests, 35 caldav unit tests, and the full backend suite pass.
verification_commands: cargo test --test application --test authorization --test authorization_regression --test backup --test bootstrap
follow_up: Untracked scratch test files backend/tests/scratch_axum.rs and backend/tests/scratch_ics.rs remain in the tree; they pass but are dev scratch artifacts that should be removed before merge.
important_context: ETag is a quoted SHA-256 of the serialized VCALENDAR (ical.rs etag_for_ical); canonical content embeds event.created_at as DTSTAMP and event.version as SEQUENCE, so any domain update rotates the ETag.

Resource mapping is created lazily on first PROPFIND listing (ensure_resource) and persisted in caldav_event_resources (migration 0024) with unique (calendar_id, uid) and (calendar_id, resource_name).
GET/HEAD only expose timed, non-recurring events; all-day and recurring events return 404 by design for this slice.
